name: briefing_action_queue_add_play_sample_by_name
description: Briefing_ActionQueue::AddPlaySampleByName allocates a play-sample action, copies the sample name, stores gain and variant/progress fields, inserts the action, and returns the updated node count.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean in briefing_action_queue_add_methods and both covering VC5 targets; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because tick bodies and the runtime constructor remain byte-blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4049d0 validates EH-framed allocation of a 0x60-byte play-sample action, 0x50-byte strncpy, gain/useVariant/progress storage, queue-node insertion, node-count increment, and return of the updated count.
The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies the generated briefing sample name, gain, variant flag, and first progress id.
